explanations.8: The ?. operator safely accesses nested properties (won't crash if metadata is missing), and ?? provides a fallback value of empty string if the result is null or undefined; the regex removes leading and trailing slashes from the URL path.
explanations.13: This comment explains why `voted` starts as null instead of reading from localStorage immediately — it prevents a mismatch between the server (which has no localStorage) and the browser (which does).
explanations.23: The empty catch block silently ignores any errors (like when localStorage isn't available), which is intentional to handle cases where the browser restricts local storage access.
explanations.29: This checks if the response status was successful (r.ok), and if so parses the JSON; otherwise it returns null to avoid crashing on bad responses.
explanations.39: The body is being serialized to JSON as a string because the fetch API requires the body to be a string, not a JavaScript object.
